pairs.note: The key does not say the field is inapplicable; it describes a substantive mechanism: a perpetual, inception-to-date loss carryforward (realized losses and unrealized depreciation) that must be recovered before further capital gains incentive fees, while confirming no high-water mark/look-back on the income incentive fee. The answer's flat NOT_APPLICABLE omits the capital gains loss-carryforward element entirely and conveys that no such mechanism exists, so it misses a required element and reverses part of the meaning.
